##### Project general facts

Dania District is a residential development by Deyaar comprising six contemporary residential buildings within the Midtown community. The project offers a range of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to combine modern architecture with practical living spaces. The buildings feature contemporary glass façades, spacious layouts, and balconies overlooking landscaped communal areas. The overall design concept emphasizes a balance between urban living and integrated green spaces, creating a cohesive residential environment suited to a variety of lifestyles.

Residents have access to a wide selection of indoor and outdoor amenities designed for recreation, wellness, and social interaction. The development features a central landscaped park, community spaces, recreational facilities, retail and dining options, entertainment areas, walking paths, and leisure zones. The extensive amenity offering is designed to support family living while providing opportunities for relaxation, outdoor activities, and community engagement.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. Interior spaces are designed with a contemporary aesthetic and durable finishes that support comfortable everyday living. No kitchen appliances are specified. Apartments are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing standards with quality materials and practical residential layouts.
 
##### Location description and benefits
 
Dubai Production City is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

Dubai Production City also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
